public_views.name: inspection_room_requirements
public_views.definition:
SELECT p.id AS property_id,
    p.manager_user_id,
    rooms.room ->> 'id'::text AS room_id,
    rooms.room ->> 'name'::text AS room_name,
    ((rooms.room -> 'requireMoveInInspection'::text) = 'true'::jsonb) IS TRUE AS move_in_required,
    ((rooms.room -> 'requireMoveOutInspection'::text) = 'true'::jsonb) IS TRUE AS move_out_required
   FROM manager_property_records p
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(COALESCE((p.property_data -> 'listingSubmission'::text) -> 'rooms'::text, (p.row_data -> 'submission'::text) -> 'rooms'::text)) = 'array'::text THEN COALESCE((p.property_data -> 'listingSubmission'::text) -> 'rooms'::text, (p.row_data -> 'submission'::text) -> 'rooms'::text)
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END) rooms(room)
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(rooms.room) = 'object'::text AND COALESCE(rooms.room ->> 'id'::text, ''::text) <> ''::text;
